services.pageDescription: GIX Nexus Telecom and Power offers six core service groupings covering the full lifecycle of telecommunications and power infrastructure, from site survey through installation, commissioning, and ongoing maintenance.

telecomInfrastructure.name: Telecommunications Infrastructure
telecomInfrastructure.description: Comprehensive installation and maintenance of outdoor and indoor telecommunications facilities, equipment, and site support services.
capabilities: Outdoor & Indoor Facilities Installation and Maintenance

fiberOptic.name: Fiber Optic Solutions
fiberOptic.description: End-to-end fiber optic services from cable installation to testing and preventive maintenance.

satelliteWireless.name: Satellite & Wireless Communications
satelliteWireless.description: Installation, alignment, and maintenance of VSAT, satellite, microwave, and RF communication systems.

networkInfrastructure.name: Network Infrastructure
networkInfrastructure.description: Structured cabling, LAN/WAN infrastructure, network rack installation, and commissioning services.
capabilities: Network Rack Installation and Cable Management

telecomPower.name: Telecom Power Systems
telecomPower.description: DC power systems, rectifiers, UPS, battery banks, and earthing and lightning protection for telecom sites.

maintenance.name: Maintenance & Technical Support
maintenance.description: Preventive and corrective maintenance, emergency fault response, and technical inspection services.

company.overviewText: GIX Nexus Telecom and Power is an Ethiopian-owned telecommunications and power engineering company headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We deliver reliable, innovative, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions, operating across Ethiopia with a commitment to quality, safety, and professionalism.
company.vision: To become one of Ethiopia's leading telecommunications and power engineering companies, recognized for quality, innovation, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
missionPoints: Provide innovative and reliable technical solutions
Contribute to the growth of Ethiopia's digital infrastructure

hseq.policyText: At GIX Nexus Telecom and Power, safety is our highest priority. Our HSEQ Policy governs every project, ensuring all personnel, partners, and the environment are protected throughout the project lifecycle.
hseq.zeroAccidentDescription: Our Zero Accident Objective represents our unwavering commitment to eliminate workplace incidents. This is a goal and safety commitment, not a reported metric.
hseq.safetyFirstDescription: 100% Safety-first approach on every project is our operating policy — applied without exception to every job site and task.
